definitions.explanation: A low area between hills or mountains.

examples.english: To go down into the valley.

examples.japanese: {谷|たに}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: A river flows through the valley.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧{谷|たに}⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Life has its ups and downs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{谷|たに}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: I fell into a deep ravine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{谷底|たにそこ}→谷底：14264_tanisoko⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧。
examples.english: It's so deep you can't see the bottom of the gorge.

notes:
{谷|たに} means valley—a low area of land between hills or mountains, often with a river.

READINGS:
- {谷|たに}: standard reading
- {谷|や}/{谷|やつ}: in place names (⟦{渋谷|しぶや}→渋谷：noentry⟧, ⟦{四谷|よつや}→四谷：noentry⟧)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {谷|たに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}る→下る：03913_kudaru⟧: to go down into the valley
- {谷|たに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧: to cross a valley
- {谷|たに}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall into a ravine

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{谷間|たにま}→谷間：27796_tanima⟧: valley, ravine; cleavage
- ⟦{谷底|たにそこ}→谷底：14264_tanisoko⟧: bottom of a valley
- ⟦{渓谷|けいこく}→渓谷：10932_keikoku⟧: gorge, ravine
- ⟦{峡谷|きょうこく}→峡谷：05037_kyoukoku⟧: canyon

IDIOMATIC:
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧{谷|たに}⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧: ups and downs (in life)
